selection_basis: prespecified CRC biology and repository gene sets only; no DSS labels

concepts.fixed_medical_description: Interferon and cytotoxic immune activation within an inflamed colorectal tumour microenvironment.
concepts.pathology_morphology_description: Lymphocyte-rich tumour interface, tumour-infiltrating immune cells, and necro-inflammatory foci.
concepts.omics_biological_description: Interferon response, antigen presentation, allograft-rejection-like and IL2-STAT5 transcriptional activity.
concepts.clinical_interpretation: A stronger signal is compatible with an immune-inflamed phenotype; it is not a treatment-response label.
concepts.text_source: fixed author-written description; no LLM or patient outcome input

concepts.fixed_medical_description: Canonical epithelial identity with WNT-beta-catenin and MYC-driven transcriptional activity.
concepts.pathology_morphology_description: Cohesive gland-forming epithelial architecture, preserved polarity, and epithelial tumour nests.
concepts.omics_biological_description: WNT-beta-catenin, MYC target, and KRAS-upstream epithelial programme activity.
concepts.clinical_interpretation: A stronger signal indicates epithelial tumour biology and does not itself encode DSS outcome.
concepts.text_source: fixed author-written description; no LLM or patient outcome input

concepts.fixed_medical_description: Tumour metabolic state spanning glycolysis, oxidative phosphorylation, lipid handling, and peroxisomal metabolism.
concepts.pathology_morphology_description: Morphologic heterogeneity compatible with metabolic stress, mucinous change, or altered tumour-cell cytoplasm.
concepts.omics_biological_description: Glycolytic, oxidative-phosphorylation, fatty-acid, bile-acid, and peroxisome pathway activity.
concepts.clinical_interpretation: A metabolic signal is a molecular phenotype summary, not a direct clinical risk score.
concepts.text_source: fixed author-written description; no LLM or patient outcome input

concepts.fixed_medical_description: Mesenchymal and stromal remodelling driven by TGF-beta and tumour-stroma interaction.
concepts.pathology_morphology_description: Desmoplastic stroma, spindle-cell or fibroblast-rich areas, and stromal expansion around tumour glands.
concepts.omics_biological_description: TGF-beta, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, angiogenic, and apical-junction remodelling activity.
concepts.clinical_interpretation: A stronger signal indicates stromal or mesenchymal context and does not establish causality for outcome.
concepts.text_source: fixed author-written description; no LLM or patient outcome input

concepts.fixed_medical_description: Tumour proliferation and cell-cycle activity spanning E2F, mitotic spindle, G2M, DNA repair, and MYC programmes.
concepts.pathology_morphology_description: High mitotic activity, increased nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, and proliferative tumour regions.
concepts.omics_biological_description: E2F target, G2M checkpoint, mitotic-spindle, DNA-repair, and MYC target activity.
concepts.clinical_interpretation: A proliferative signal is a biological state descriptor and is not selected using DSS labels.
concepts.text_source: fixed author-written description; no LLM or patient outcome input

concepts.fixed_medical_description: Hypoxic tumour stress and vascular adaptation, including angiogenic and reactive-oxygen responses.
concepts.pathology_morphology_description: Hypoxia-compatible necrosis, irregular vascularity, hemorrhagic change, and poorly perfused tumour areas.
concepts.omics_biological_description: Hypoxia, angiogenesis, glycolysis, and reactive-oxygen pathway activity.
concepts.clinical_interpretation: This summarizes tumour microenvironment stress; it is not a patient-level survival prediction.
concepts.text_source: fixed author-written description; no LLM or patient outcome input

concepts.fixed_medical_description: Invasion and extracellular-matrix remodelling associated with EMT, cell adhesion, coagulation, and tissue-interface change.
concepts.pathology_morphology_description: Irregular invasive fronts, tumour budding, loss of cohesive architecture, and matrix-associated tumour spread.
concepts.omics_biological_description: EMT, apical-junction, coagulation, complement, and tissue-remodelling activity.
concepts.clinical_interpretation: A stronger signal indicates an invasion-related biological context without using outcome labels to define the concept.
concepts.text_source: fixed author-written description; no LLM or patient outcome input

concepts.fixed_medical_description: Inflammatory and potentially immune-suppressive tumour-microenvironment signalling through NF-kB, IL6-STAT3, and inflammatory response programmes.
concepts.pathology_morphology_description: Mixed inflammatory infiltrates, necro-inflammatory debris, and tumour-associated stromal or myeloid-rich regions.
concepts.omics_biological_description: TNF-NF-kB, IL6-JAK-STAT3, inflammatory-response, and complement pathway activity.
concepts.clinical_interpretation: This is a microenvironmental concept summary and does not label individual patient risk.
concepts.text_source: fixed author-written description; no LLM or patient outcome input
